app.name: Audorix.ChatX
app.tagline: Open-source communication, built in the open.
app.intro: This build is the platform foundation: the API host, the database layer and this localized web shell. Messaging, accounts and integrations arrive in later milestones, so nothing here is interactive beyond language and status.
app.footer: Open source under the MIT License.

readiness.title: Service status
readiness.availableDetail: The API and its database are ready to serve requests.
readiness.notReadyDetail: The API responded, but its database is unavailable or its schema has not been migrated.
readiness.unreachableDetail: The API could not be reached. Check that it is running and try again.

included.api: ASP.NET Core API with liveness and readiness checks
included.database: SQLite and PostgreSQL support with separate migrations

foundation.next: Identity and authentication: registration, sign-in and user profiles.
